feedback.parents: normal short-card variation, both tasks/seeds; reuse those first calls
feedback.construction: same prior prompt and model reply; receipt arm adds actual status/error/value, practice arm withholds receipt; both same task restatement and next-command cue
feedback.policy: include successful and failed parents, no selection/retry; prompts frozen per pair before its generation

reference.paired_subset: plain targets plus literal/definition copies, both cards/seeds
reference.intervention: all LoRALinear.scale 2 to 0 in this process only; tensors/files unchanged

scoring: entire reply stripped only; literal match, accepted execution and semantic task score separate; plain is not dispatched; feedback paired, not independent calls
